2609.09143.title: Studying Image Tokenizers as Visual Languages in Unified Multimodal Models
2609.09143.paper_summary: Image tokenizers define the ``visual language'' of unified multimodal models, yet are commonly studied through isolated metrics or generation-/understanding-only evaluations. These evaluations do not fully capture how visual tokens behave when modeled jointly with text. We build a controlled pure-autoregressive testbed and track task-specific validation losses during multimodal continual pretraining across text, image, text-to-image (T2I), and image-to-text (I2T) prediction. We examine how these losses scale and relate to downstream performance, then use them to study multimodal learnability---how well image and text tokens are jointly modeled---and tokenizer design. We find that (1) losses should be analyzed by task, since they exhibit distinct scaling behavior and rank tokenizers differently. (2) The loss--performance relationship depends on the predicted token space: for a fixed tokenizer, T2I and I2T losses correlate with generation quality, but across tokenizers, the T2I loss--performance relationship shifts with the image-token space, whereas I2T loss, computed over a shared text vocabulary, provides a more consistent signal. I2T loss also correlates with both generation and visual understanding performance after supervised finetuning. Using losses as a lens, we show that (3) better reconstruction does not necessarily yield lower task-specific losses or stronger downstream performance, and that (4) image tokenizer choice can affect text modeling under joint optimization. As case studies, we revisit three tokenizer design axes---the discriminator, semantic supervision, and vocabulary size---to examine their effects on joint modeling and downstream performance. Together, our testbed offers a complementary perspective on image tokenizers as visual languages, highlighting their interplay with text in joint multimodal training.
2609.09143.paper_summary_zh: 影像標記器定義了統一多模態模型的「視覺語言」，但通常通過孤立的指標或僅限於生成/理解的評估來研究這些標記器。這些評估未能充分捕捉視覺標記在與文本共同建模時的行為。我們建立了一個受控的純自回歸測試平台，並在多模態持續預訓練過程中跟踪文本、影像、文本到影像 (T2I) 和影像到文本 (I2T) 預測的任務特定驗證損失。我們檢查這些損失如何隨著規模變化並與下游性能相關，然後利用它們來研究多模態可學習性——影像和文本標記的聯合建模效果——以及標記器設計。我們發現 (1) 損失應根據任務進行分析，因為它們表現出不同的縮放行為並對標記器的排名有所不同。(2) 損失與性能的關係取決於預測的標記空間：對於固定的標記器，T2I 和 I2T 損失與生成質量相關，但在不同的標記器之間，T2I 損失與影像標記空間的關係會變化，而 I2T 損失在共享文本詞彙上計算，提供了更一致的信號。I2T 損失在經過監督微調後，還與生成和視覺理解性能相關。通過損失作為透鏡，我們展示了 (3) 更好的重建不一定會產生較低的任務特定損失或更強的下游性能，以及 (4) 在聯合優化下，影像標記器的選擇可能會影響文本建模。作為案例研究，我們重新檢視三個標記器設計軸——判別器、語義監督和詞彙大小——以檢查它們對聯合建模和下游性能的影響。總的來說，我們的測試平台提供了一個對影像標記器作為視覺語言的補充視角，突顯了它們在聯合多模態訓練中與文本的相互作用。
